source_text: Invenerit rem perditam et negaverit. Inventio sine confessione furtum spirituale. Veritas reddit.
pass_a_gloss: Will-have-found thing lost and will-have-denied. Finding without confession theft spiritual. Truth returns.
pass_b_english: He [[finds a lost thing and denies it >> Bible:Leviticus 6:3]]. Finding without confession is spiritual theft. Truth gives back.
